title: Code Review Simulator: ForgeNest in Dark Mode
body:
Working on PR review in ForgeNest, shown on the in-world monitor with the OS in dark mode.

The file list, diff preview, review comments, and workflow checks are visible together.

![An in-world monitor showing ForgeNest PR review in dark mode, with changed files, a diff preview, review comments, workflow checks, and approval controls.](../media/code-review-simulator-2026-10-03-forgenest-in-world-dark-mode/forgenest-in-world-dark-mode.png)
